we have proposed an extension of RDFS, namely RDFS(FA), which is compatible with OWL DL.
we have established a solid semantic foundation for the semantic Web, and have also made the first step towards a complete semantic Web.

the semantic Web is a Web that uses a single language for both data and knowledge representation.
